name: add_project
description: Register a project root with depgraph and start a long-lived language server for each detected language (Go, Rust, TypeScript). Returns immediately with {"status":"indexing"}; the LSP indexes in the background. find_symbols / find_references for that root return a "retry shortly" error until the project is ready. For mono-repo projects, call add_project once per subtree root. Pass the excludes field (doublestar globs relative to root) to omit non-production code from queries — e.g. excludes: ["**/*.test.{ts,tsx}", "**/*.spec.{ts,tsx}", "**/*_test.go"]. Pass exclude_symbols to drop framework-convention symbols whose cross-file references would otherwise fan out the graph (e.g. Next.js page-level getStaticProps / getServerSideProps).

root.description: Absolute path to the project root directory to register

excludes.description: Doublestar glob patterns relative to root to exclude from queries (e.g. ["**/*_test.go", "node_modules/**"])

exclude_symbols.description: Specs of the form `[kind:]pattern` matched against symbol name (doublestar glob). Excluded symbols are skipped during find_references BFS so they cannot fan out the graph. kind is optional and constrains the match to one LSP symbol kind (function, method, class, property, variable, ...). Examples: ["getStaticProps", "getServerSideProps", "function:getStaticPaths"].

name: find_references
description: Find every symbol that references the target symbol, recursing through the caller chain. The target is identified by symbol_id, which is obtained from find_symbols. Returns {"results": [...callers], "warnings"?: ["..."]}; presence of warnings means at least one LSP query failed and the result list is partial.

root.description: Absolute path to the project root passed to add_project

symbol_id.description: Stateless symbol identifier returned by find_symbols

name: find_symbols
description: Search for symbols in a registered project by name. Walk every source file under the project root, ask the language server for that file's symbols, and fuzzy-match their names against the query (case-insensitive subsequence). Returns {"results": [...symbols], "warnings"?: ["..."]}; each result carries a stateless id usable with find_references plus its name, kind, path (relative to root), and 0-based line/character. Presence of warnings means at least one file's lookup failed and the result list is partial. Cost scales with project size.

root.description: Absolute path to the project root passed to add_project

query.description: Fuzzy match query — characters of query must appear in order inside a symbol name (case-insensitive). Empty string returns every symbol.
